connectionUi.accessSummary.accessStaysAs.en: agent access stays as it is
connectionUi.accessSummary.accessStaysAs.zh-CN: 智能体访问权限保持不变

connectionUi.accessSummary.availableToRe.en: available to the agent that asked for it
connectionUi.accessSummary.availableToRe.zh-CN: 提出请求的智能体可使用

connectionUi.accessSummary.connectsAsDed.en: Connects as a dedicated agent account
connectionUi.accessSummary.connectsAsDed.zh-CN: 将作为专属智能体账户连接

connectionUi.accessSummary.connectsForEv.en: Connects for everyone in your organization
connectionUi.accessSummary.connectsForEv.zh-CN: 将为组织中的所有人连接

connectionUi.accountChoice.externalProvi.en: {{provider}} is an external service that handles the connection and requests to {{service}}. Reusing this account does not yet verify app access; the agent will check it and guide any additional authorization.
connectionUi.accountChoice.externalProvi.zh-CN: {{provider}} 是处理与 {{service}} 连接和请求的外部服务。重复使用此账户尚不会验证应用访问权限；智能体会进行检查并指导完成其他授权。

connectionUi.actionTest.afterApproval.en: After approval, test the {{action}} action with this execution ID. Do not start the original action again.
connectionUi.actionTest.afterApproval.zh-CN: 批准后，请使用此执行 ID 测试 {{action}} 操作。不要再次发起原始操作。

connectionUi.actionTest.gutCheck.allowed.en: This runs a real call against {{app}} as {{agent}}.
connectionUi.actionTest.gutCheck.allowed.zh-CN: 将以 {{agent}} 身份对 {{app}} 发起真实调用。

connectionUi.actionTest.gutCheck.askFirs.en: Waiting for your OK before this call leaves Paperclip.
connectionUi.actionTest.gutCheck.askFirs.zh-CN: 此调用离开 Paperclip 前会等待你的批准。

connectionUi.actionTest.gutCheck.off.en: No call will be made — this action is off for {{agent}}.
connectionUi.actionTest.gutCheck.off.zh-CN: 不会发起调用：已为 {{agent}} 关闭此操作。

connectionUi.adoption.responsibleUserDef.en: Responsible user’s default. For you: {{connection}}. Other users use their own default.
connectionUi.adoption.responsibleUserDef.zh-CN: 负责人默认账户。你使用：{{connection}}。其他用户使用各自的默认账户。

connectionUi.apiKey.pasteForProvider.zh-CN: 粘贴你的 {{provider}} API 密钥

connectionUi.catalog.aggregator.connectA.zh-CN: 通过第三方服务 {{provider}} 连接 {{app}}

connectionUi.catalog.aggregator.manageAr.zh-CN: 通过第三方服务 {{provider}} 管理 {{app}}

connectionUi.catalog.chatWithAgentsThrou.zh-CN: 通过 {{provider}} 与智能体聊天。

connectionUi.catalog.pagination.range.zh-CN: 第 {{start}}–{{end}} 项，共 {{total}} 个连接器

connectionUi.intent.accessRequest.title.zh-CN: 要授予 {{agent}} 对“{{connection}}”的访问权限吗？

connectionUi.intent.adoptionReadyDescrip.en: Your account is connected. Use it for {{agent}} to resume this task.
connectionUi.intent.adoptionReadyDescrip.zh-CN: 你的账户已连接。请将其用于 {{agent}} 以恢复此任务。

connectionUi.intent.agentAiConnectionCha.en: The agent’s AI connection changed. Reload the task and try again.
connectionUi.intent.agentAiConnectionCha.zh-CN: 该智能体的 AI 连接已更改。请重新加载任务后重试。

connectionUi.intent.agentMailDescription.en: Connect AgentMail to create an email address for this agent.
connectionUi.intent.agentMailDescription.zh-CN: 连接 AgentMail，为此智能体创建电子邮件地址。

connectionUi.intent.authorizationRetryNo.en: Authorization didn’t finish. Your previous choices are safe; try again.
connectionUi.intent.authorizationRetryNo.zh-CN: 授权未完成。此前选择已安全保存，请重试。

connectionUi.intent.continueWhenRestored.en: You can continue here once it is restored.

connectionUi.intent.identityConnectionDe.en: Connect your identity or reuse an eligible connection. Access is added only for this agent.
connectionUi.intent.identityConnectionDe.zh-CN: 连接你的身份，或重复使用符合条件的连接。访问权限仅授予此智能体。

connectionUi.intent.ownAiConnectionDescr.en: {{agent}} needs your own AI connection. Connect here and the task will resume automatically.
connectionUi.intent.ownAiConnectionDescr.zh-CN: {{agent}} 需要你的 AI 连接。在此连接后，任务将自动恢复。

connectionUi.intent.selectedAccountUnava.en: The selected account is no longer available to you. Ask its owner to restore access, or choose an available AI connection in the agent’s settings.
connectionUi.intent.selectedAccountUnava.zh-CN: 所选账户已不再对你可用。请其所有者恢复访问权限，或在智能体设置中选择可用的 AI 连接。

connectionUi.intent.setupDialogDescripti.en: Complete connection setup without leaving this task.
connectionUi.intent.setupDialogDescripti.zh-CN: 无需离开此任务即可完成连接设置。

connectionUi.intent.status.aiConnectionR.en: This agent can now use the connection.
connectionUi.intent.status.aiConnectionR.zh-CN: 该智能体现在可以使用此连接。

connectionUi.intent.status.aiConnectionR.en: The task still needs a working AI connection before it can run.
connectionUi.intent.status.aiConnectionR.zh-CN: 任务仍需可用的 AI 连接才能运行。

connectionUi.intent.status.connectionDec.en: {{agent}} was notified and can continue without it.
connectionUi.intent.status.connectionDec.zh-CN: {{agent}} 已收到通知，可在没有此连接的情况下继续。

connectionUi.intent.status.connectionRea.en: {{agent}} can use this connection on the continuation run.
connectionUi.intent.status.connectionRea.zh-CN: {{agent}} 可在后续运行中使用此连接。

connectionUi.intent.status.externalProvi.en: {{agent}} can now verify and authorize {{service}} through this provider. The app is not yet verified.
connectionUi.intent.status.externalProvi.zh-CN: {{agent}} 现在可通过此服务商验证并授权 {{service}}。该应用尚未验证。

connectionUi.intent.status.requestNoLong.en: This request is no longer active.

connectionUi.intent.status.requestSupers.en: This request was replaced. Use the latest connection card instead.
connectionUi.intent.status.requestSupers.zh-CN: 此请求已被替换。请改用最新的连接卡片。

connectionUi.intent.taskAiConnectionDesc.en: This task can’t run until the agent has a valid AI connection. Connect here and the task will resume automatically.
connectionUi.intent.taskAiConnectionDesc.zh-CN: 该任务需为智能体配置有效的 AI 连接才能运行。在此连接后，任务将自动恢复。

connectionUi.intent.useConnectionForAgen.en: Use your {{provider}} connection for {{agent}}? This replaces the agent’s existing authentication with each responsible person’s own account. The model stays the same.
connectionUi.intent.useConnectionForAgen.zh-CN: 要将你的 {{provider}} 连接用于 {{agent}} 吗？这会用每位负责人的账户替换该智能体现有的身份验证，模型保持不变。

connectionUi.pasteConfig.foundApps_one.en: We found {{count}} app in that config
connectionUi.pasteConfig.foundApps_one.zh-CN: 在该配置中找到 {{count}} 个应用

connectionUi.pasteConfig.foundApps_other.en: We found {{count}} apps in that config
connectionUi.pasteConfig.foundApps_other.zh-CN: 在该配置中找到 {{count}} 个应用

connectionUi.remoteMcp.connectedActionsA.zh-CN: 已连接{{identity}} · 可用操作 {{count}} 个
已连接{{identity}} · 可用操作 {{count}} 个

connectionUi.remoteMcp.providerHandlesSe.en: {{provider}} handles the connection and requests to {{service}}.
connectionUi.remoteMcp.providerHandlesSe.zh-CN: {{provider}} 负责连接和向 {{service}} 发出的请求。

connectionUi.remoteMcp.setupReadyToResum.en: Your {{provider}} setup is ready to resume.
connectionUi.remoteMcp.setupReadyToResum.zh-CN: 你的 {{provider}} 设置已可继续。

connectionUi.remoteMcp.useOnYourBehalf.en: Paperclip will use {{provider}} on your behalf.

connectionUi.setup.browserSignInUnsuppor.en: This environment does not support browser sign-in. Choose a sign-in environment or connect with an API key.
connectionUi.setup.browserSignInUnsuppor.zh-CN: 此环境不支持浏览器登录。请选择登录环境或改用 API 密钥连接。

connectionUi.setup.checkKeyAndRetry.en: Please check your key and try again.
connectionUi.setup.checkKeyAndRetry.zh-CN: 请检查你的密钥后重试。

connectionUi.setup.enrollment.checkRegis.en: Paperclip couldn’t check Cloud registration. Try again.
connectionUi.setup.enrollment.checkRegis.zh-CN: Paperclip 无法检查 Cloud 注册状态。请重试。

connectionUi.setup.enrollment.cloudUnava.en: Paperclip couldn’t reach Paperclip Cloud. Try again.
connectionUi.setup.enrollment.cloudUnava.zh-CN: Paperclip 无法连接到 Paperclip Cloud。请重试。

connectionUi.setup.enrollment.missingEnr.en: Paperclip Cloud did not return an enrollment link. Try again.
connectionUi.setup.enrollment.missingEnr.zh-CN: Paperclip Cloud 未返回注册链接。请重试。

connectionUi.setup.enrollment.openAuthor.en: Open authorization in a new tab to continue.
connectionUi.setup.enrollment.openAuthor.zh-CN: 请在新标签页中打开授权以继续。

connectionUi.setup.galleryDescription.en: Pick the app you want your agents to use.
connectionUi.setup.galleryDescription.zh-CN: 选择希望智能体使用的应用。

connectionUi.setup.galleryVercelDescript.en: Choose a reviewed app to connect through Vercel.
connectionUi.setup.galleryVercelDescript.zh-CN: 选择一个经审核的应用以通过 Vercel 连接。

connectionUi.setup.githubInstallationReq.en: GitHub access is required. Install Paperclip and grant at least one repository, then try again.
connectionUi.setup.githubInstallationReq.zh-CN: 需要 GitHub 访问权限。请安装 Paperclip 并至少授权一个仓库，然后重试。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.authorizationCa.en: Authorization was cancelled. You can try again.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.authorizationCa.zh-CN: 授权已取消。你可以重试。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.authorizationEx.en: Your authorization expired or was revoked. Reconnect to continue.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.authorizationEx.zh-CN: 你的授权已过期或被撤销。请重新连接以继续。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.authorizationIn.en: Authorization did not complete. Try again when you’re ready.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.authorizationIn.zh-CN: 授权未完成。准备好后请重试。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.checkExistingCo.en: Paperclip couldn’t check for an existing connection. Try again.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.checkExistingCo.zh-CN: Paperclip 无法检查现有连接。请重试。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.confirmConnecti.en: Could not confirm the connection. Try again.

connectionUi.setup.oauth.continueAtHost.en: Continue at {{host}} to choose a workspace and approve access. Only approve access if you recognize that address.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.continueAtHost.zh-CN: 请在 {{host}} 继续选择工作区并批准访问。仅当你确认该地址可信时才批准访问。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.continueInProvi.en: Continue in {{server}} to choose a workspace and approve access.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.continueInProvi.zh-CN: 请在 {{server}} 中继续选择工作区并批准访问。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.creatingConnect.en: Paperclip is creating a secure {{server}} connection.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.creatingConnect.zh-CN: Paperclip 正在创建安全的 {{server}} 连接。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.finishInSignInW.en: Authorization did not complete. Finish setup in the sign-in window or try again.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.finishInSignInW.zh-CN: 授权未完成。请在登录窗口中完成设置，或重试。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.githubSignInWin.en: The sign-in window closed. Try again to finish connecting GitHub.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.githubSignInWin.zh-CN: 登录窗口已关闭。请重试以完成 GitHub 连接。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.openProviderDes.en: Paperclip will open {{server}} so you can choose a workspace and approve access.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.openProviderDes.zh-CN: Paperclip 将打开 {{server}}，以便你选择工作区并批准访问。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.openSignInInNew.en: Open sign-in in a new tab
connectionUi.setup.oauth.openSignInInNew.zh-CN: 在新标签页中打开登录

connectionUi.setup.oauth.preserveSignInF.en: Paperclip couldn’t preserve this sign-in while refreshing your account.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.preserveSignInF.zh-CN: Paperclip 在刷新你的账户时无法保留此次登录。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.savedConnection.en: Your connection is saved. Continue in {{server}} to approve access; its identity and agent access will stay the same.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.savedConnection.zh-CN: 连接已保存。请在 {{server}} 中继续批准访问；其身份和智能体访问权限将保持不变。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.signInWindowClo.en: The sign-in window closed. If authorization did not finish, try again.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.signInWindowClo.zh-CN: 登录窗口已关闭。若授权尚未完成，请重试。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.signInWindowUna.en: Paperclip couldn’t open the sign-in window. Open sign-in in a new tab to continue.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.signInWindowUna.zh-CN: Paperclip 无法打开登录窗口。请在新标签页中打开登录以继续。

connectionUi.setup.oauth.startSignInFail.en: Paperclip couldn’t start secure sign-in. Try again.
connectionUi.setup.oauth.startSignInFail.zh-CN: Paperclip 无法启动安全登录。请重试。

connectionUi.setup.oauthCancelled.en: Authorization was cancelled or declined. Your saved connection was not changed.
connectionUi.setup.oauthCancelled.zh-CN: 授权已取消或被拒绝。已保存的连接未被更改。

connectionUi.setup.oauthIncomplete.en: Authorization did not complete. Your saved connection is still here, so you can try again.
connectionUi.setup.oauthIncomplete.zh-CN: 授权未完成。已保存的连接仍在此处，你可以重试。

connectionUi.setup.providerNeedsOwnOAuth.zh-CN: {{provider}} 需要使用自己的 OAuth 应用

connectionUi.setup.signInUnavailableDesc.en: This instance is connected to Paperclip, but {{provider}} sign-in is not currently available. Try again shortly or contact your instance administrator.
connectionUi.setup.signInUnavailableDesc.zh-CN: 此实例已连接到 Paperclip，但目前无法登录 {{provider}}。请稍后重试或联系实例管理员。

connectionUi.setup.useOwnOAuthApp.zh-CN: 使用你自己的 {{provider}} OAuth 应用

connectionUi.useSavedApiKey.zh-CN: 使用已保存的 API 密钥
